measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only until internal evidence-gap audit passes
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only spans whose durable evidence-point gaps all satisfy the <=120s contract may be promoted to counted useful span.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended observation window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s evaluation window
measurement.scheduler_migration_note: Fixed-quarter feasibility arithmetic is historical. Rolling samples measure actual due, observed wake, work evidence, final rearm, subsequent wake, and unexplained gaps.
measurement.signed_delivery_offset_definition: worker_observed_at - expected_wake_at; negative means early invocation, positive means late invocation. Never clamp early observations to zero.

meaningful_outputs: stale durable due recovered forward without rollback
active_turn_observation.note: Do not classify the full +164s as scheduler delivery delay because durable predecessor state remained at the 04:07 handoff after an intervening attempted run. latest_completed_turn.reason: Valid historical fixed-quarter evidence retained for comparison, but not counted as rolling-lifecycle acceptance sample.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: The 04:09:44 invocation is +164s relative to stale durable 04:07 expected due, but an intervening attempted run did not durably advance predecessor state. Therefore the entire interval cannot safely be assigned to scheduler jitter.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: No complete 900s rolling sample yet. Need a clean committed final-rearm -> observed wake pair plus <=120s internal evidence gaps.

next_corrective_experiment.change: At normal close persist checkpoint, final-rearm same canonical, verify live mutation, then persist exact expected due only after verification; next worker must record observed invocation before any scheduler mutation and retain both timestamps.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: At least one clean final-rearm -> next-wake pair with attributable signed delivery offset, followed by complete rolling windows suitable for P0 promotion.
